---
title: "Step 2: Standardize and Validate"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r batch knit}

# Remove all objects from the environment to ensure a clean slate for knitting
rm(list=ls(all=TRUE))

# Batch knit all Rmd files in the current directory, excluding this one
files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.Rmd$")
filtered_files <- files[!grepl("B99_BATCH_KNIT_STEP2.Rmd", files)]
for (f in filtered_files) {
  rmarkdown::render(f,
                    quiet = TRUE)
}

```
